component.name: APS MIDI Prep Tool
component.summary: Prepare and preserve Disklavier MIDI, E-SEQ, floppy, and image data

description.p: APS MIDI Prep Tool is a Disklavier preservation and preparation workstation for MIDI files, Yamaha E-SEQ files, floppy images, and physical floppy disks.
It can build numbered emulator disk sets containing either Standard MIDI files only or Yamaha E-SEQ files with a correct PIANODIR.FIL on every image.
Improve floppy-write recovery, emulator-image transactions, MIDI output selection, preparation preferences, and translations.
Create verified Mark IV library backups, preserve MIDI controller state and note endings, protect recordings during conversion and renaming, and support portable deployment and Windows image tools.
Prepare songs for Disklavier, PianoDisc, and QRS controllers, review staged changes and emulator disks, and use all 12 interface languages.
